summary: Upgrading from 2.4 to 2.6 imports controller authenticators and mappings into the gateway, while from 2.5 the gateway's authenticators continue unchanged. AAP 2.6 uses PostgreSQL 15 for managed databases and supports PostgreSQL 15, 16 and 17 for external databases.
questions: Which PostgreSQL versions does AAP 2.6 support?
Can I use PostgreSQL 17 with AAP 2.6?
Are authenticators re-imported when upgrading from 2.5 to 2.6?
